import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame(
    {
        "date": ["2026-07-01", "2026-07-01", "2026-07-02", "2026-07-02"],
        "city": ["NYC", "LA", "NYC", "LA"],
        "temperature": [25.0, 30.0, 26.5, 29.0],
    }
).with_columns(pl.col("date").str.to_date())

wide = df.pivot(on="city", index="date", values="temperature").sort("date")
